name: Anand
headline: I build voice AI that works on real phone calls.
intro: AI engineer with about six years of experience. I ship multilingual voice agents, LLM serving and retrieval systems into production at VMax e‑Solutions.
about:
I work on the full path of a voice call: streaming transcription, language routing across Hindi, Telugu and English, LLM inference, tool calling and speech synthesis.

Most of my effort goes into latency, concurrency and accuracy under real traffic, not demos.
contact: Open to senior AI and GenAI engineering roles and to conversations about voice systems.
